description: Fetch a public live Seenly video-resume profile by its URL slug (the part after /u/). Returns a public card (name, role, location, skills, profile URL). Unlisted drafts, missing slugs, and non-live profiles return not found. Never use this to reach a private draft.

slug.description: Public profile slug, such as jordan-mason from seenly.live/u/jordan-mason.

name: get_public_profile
title: Get public Seenly profile
